architecture_summary: A six-phase linear pipeline (Gate -> Normalize -> Structure -> Lane roles -> Graph -> Extract) implemented as a ~1500-line Python package `tlccore/`, orchestrated by `pipeline.analyze(image_path, run_dir)`. Normalize finds the plate via HSV green mask + perspective warp, standardizes to 700px height, trims dark crop borders, and builds a log-OD map (-log10(I/bg)) against an iteratively-masked box-blur background, with a MAD noise floor from the signed OD map. Gate applies 4 hard checks (green dominance, edge density, dark content, lane evidence) producing only NOT_A_PLATE / NOT_WORKABLE refusals. Structure finds a handwriting header band, origin dots (fill-ratio discriminated from glyph rows), pencil lines via gutter-column medians, and lanes from projection peaks UNION dot positions plus regular-pitch completion. Extract fits sub-pixel multi-Gaussians per lane profile, tiers spots by SNR (confirmed >=3sigma / candidate 2-3sigma), measures streak fraction, cross-lane stacking, gutter hygiene, lane bleed, Rs pairs, and a width-vs-position model. Confidence is multiplicative named factors quantized to 0.05 with (dormant) hysteresis; every phase writes a replayable trace.json; results carry a cannot_conclude catalogue with reasons and bench remedies. There are no tests, no version pinning, no FastAPI/SQLite layer, no NN2 value tagging, and analyze() mixes I/O with computation. Lane labels come from a hardcoded "VLM cache" identical for all 7 plates.

module_reports.purpose: Phase B: plate localization (HSV green mask -> minAreaRect -> perspective warp -> 700px standardize), dark-border trim, orientation resolution (VLM answer or dot test or 'assumed'), and log-OD map with iterative-masked background and MAD noise floor.
module_reports.quality: Best module in the repo. to_od (lines 143-164) is genuinely F5-compliant: iterative-masked box-blur background + -log10(I/bg), no Kubelka-Munk, no rolling ball. The signed-OD MAD insight (clipping at 0 zeroes the MAD) is real and correct. _trim_border (38-70) solves a documented failure (border column reads as OD 0.36 and inflates MAD). Deterministic given pinned deps. No tests. Magic constants: HUE 30-100, SAT_FLOOR 55, BG_KERNEL_FRAC 0.35, the 70th-percentile background cut, trim ratio 3.0.
module_reports.issues: F4 tension: noise is computed AFTER the iterative background masking and on a percentile-trimmed (below-70th) population -- that is spot masking before sigma. sat_frac (line 163) is measured on the warped, Lanczos-resampled image (g>=254): interpolation smears clipped regions, so the clipping fraction is biased; it must be measured on raw sensor pixels before any warp. Lanczos and cv2 behavior vary across OpenCV builds -- NN5 needs pinning. VAL_FLOOR, the 70th percentile, and trim params are absent from params_hash.

module_reports.purpose: Phase A input gate: green dominance, edge density, dark content, lane evidence, resolution floor; emits PASS / NOT_A_PLATE / NOT_WORKABLE with measured-vs-needed per check.
module_reports.quality: Clean, deterministic, well-shaped refusals (Check records name/measured/needed/passed -- good NN3 raw material). Constants (GREEN_DOMINANCE_MIN=5, EDGE_DENSITY_MAX=0.06, DARK_CONTENT_MIN=0.005) are unvalidated magic tuned on 7 plates. No tests.
module_reports.issues: F1 VIOLATION: there is NO clipping-fraction check in the gate. P29 runs with 59.2% clipped pixels, passes, status OK, and share_pct photometry is published (merely caveated). The brief demands refusal of photometry above a clipping threshold. Layering smell: gate imports find_origin_dots from structure (line 63), so 'phase A' silently runs phase-C machinery. Canny on line 52 is another cross-version cv2 hazard for NN5.

module_reports.purpose: Phase C: measured header band (fill-ratio glyph detection), origin-dot row detection with row selection (dots vs handwritten labels by fill ratio 0.68 cut), pencil lines from lane-gutter medians, lane finding (projection peaks UNION dots), regular-pitch lane completion gated on OD support.
module_reports.quality: The most algorithmically valuable module. Gutter-median line detection (196-236: 'spots cannot lift a gutter median') is a genuinely clever, robust separation of drawn lines from spots. Fill-ratio dot/glyph discrimination (DOT_COMPACT=0.68 vs measured 0.70-0.81 dots, 0.48-0.66 glyphs) is empirical but calibrated on only these 7 plates. Pitch completion refuses slots without OD support and flags everything for user confirmation. Deterministic. No tests. Heavy magic-constant load (GLYPH_FILL, HDR_GAP, EDGE_GUARD, DOT_MERGE_X, ROW_TOL, SUPPORT_K) -- several NOT in params_hash.
module_reports.issues: F10 VIOLATION: lane count is derived entirely from signal (projection peaks + dots + pitch extrapolation, lines 239-336). It is flagged via needs_user_confirmation, but the count is still emitted and used downstream. Inconsistency: detect_header_band measures the real header bottom, but find_lanes (line 241) still projects from the FIXED SPOT_BAND_TOP=0.28 -- the measured band is only used in extract. Dot merging (line 186) constructs the merged Dot without compactness, silently resetting it to the 1.0 default. drawn_low origin fallback (222-229) uses hardcoded 0.62h/0.06h windows.

module_reports.purpose: Shared projection helpers: MAD, robust sigma, box-blur detrend, edge-trimmed x-projection, noise-relative peak finding (prominence = 3*MAD, never max-relative).
module_reports.quality: Small, pure, correct, deterministic. The noise-relative-prominence + trim-before-MAD discipline is right and documented. No tests.
module_reports.issues: None serious. cv2.blur used for detrending is another cv2 dependency where pure numpy convolution would ease NN5 pinning.

module_reports.purpose: Phase F: lane profiles (savgol-smoothed), multi-Gaussian sub-pixel fit with pcov-derived position errors, SNR tiers, streak fraction with quantification suppression, lane-bleed x-extent, gutter hygiene, cross-lane stacking of sub-threshold bumps, Rs pairs, width-vs-position model.
module_reports.quality: Dense but coherent. Streak suppression (lines 102-105, STREAK_LIMIT=0.55) satisfies the flag-and-do-not-quantify half of F11. Rs formula (213-215) is dimensionally correct (dy/(2(s1+s2)) equals the 4-sigma base-width convention). Cross-lane stacking (177-190) and the sigma floor noise/sqrt(ncols) (93-101) are physically motivated. curve_fit is deterministic given pinned scipy but that pinning does not exist. No tests. Magic: TIER thresholds, STACK_MIN/LANES, 2.2x bleed cut, 0.08h near-text cut, initial sigma 6.0, bounds +/-8px, 1.5-40px.
module_reports.issues: F11 VIOLATION: peak model is symmetric multi-Gaussian (_multi_gauss, 66-71), not EMG -- tailing peaks will bias centroids and integrals, which feed share_pct. F4 VIOLATION: per-lane sigma is RE-estimated from each profile (robust_sigma(prof), line 101) rather than derived once from the plate noise; the floor noise/sqrt(ncols) is actually the F4-compliant derivation and should replace, not merely floor, the re-estimate. Silent curve_fit failure fallback (121-123) invents sigma=6.0, mu_err=2.0 -- fabricated error bars with no tag distinguishing them from fitted ones (NN2 problem in miniature). share_pct is still computed on clipped plates (F1). Only pk[:10] peaks are fit with no note when peaks are dropped.

module_reports.purpose: Phase D: lexicon-first lane-role resolution (seed lexicon, condition-code regex, single-letter heuristic), structural cross-check that demotes contradicted roles, plus a hardcoded VLM_LABEL_CACHE for the 7 plates.
module_reports.quality: The ladder itself (resolve_roles, structural_crosscheck) is deterministic, simple, and sound: never guess, demote on contradiction, ask the user. role_conf values (0.95/0.75/0.55/0.3) are pulled from the air. No tests.
module_reports.issues: VLM_LABEL_CACHE (lines 73-77) is a red flag: identical labels [S, co, R, Sd] and identical confidences for ALL seven plates, generated by a dict comprehension -- this is a stub masquerading as 'recorded verbatim' cached reads. Its confidences flow into user-visible role_conf, an NN1 hazard (numbers originating in a non-deterministic VLM, and here likely fabricated). Any port must replace this with a real content-addressed, pinned-model cache or user-supplied lane maps.

module_reports.purpose: Phase E: pixel-faithful graph span, y->Rf/relative-position conversion, per-plate vmax (99.7th percentile).
module_reports.issues: F2 HAZARD: to_rf (24-30) silently returns relative position when no front exists and a 'relative Rf against origin-to-top' when a front is missing but origin exists -- three different quantities out of one function with no tag on which was used. Exactly the silent-substitution pattern F2 forbids. Rst does not exist anywhere in the codebase. vmax_for's `or 1.0` fires only on exactly 0.0, fine but obscure.

module_reports.purpose: Uniform confidence: named Factor(value, reason), multiplicative combine, 0.05 quantization WITH hysteresis against a stored previous score, weakest-link propagation, stated/caveated/watchlist bands.
module_reports.quality: Factor-with-reason on every score is a strong pattern (P29 output shows it working -- no naked numbers). weakest_link is defined but never called by the pipeline (dead code). No tests.
module_reports.issues: The hysteresis (quantize, lines 24-29) is a designed-in NN1 violation: the returned number depends on a PREVIOUSLY STORED value, i.e., on run history -- the same image can yield different scores depending on what ran before. It is dormant (pipeline never passes `previous`) but porting it would inherit the hazard; the comment even claims it is 'part of the determinism invariant', which is backwards. Multiplicative combination of 5-7 factors collapses honest-but-degraded plates to 0.1 (seen on P29) -- calibration never validated against human labels (NN4-adjacent).

module_reports.purpose: Replayable per-phase trace: inputs, outputs, params, decision, reasons, artifacts -> trace.json.
module_reports.quality: Small, clean, works (P29 trace has all 6 sections). The numpy-aware JSON default is fine.
module_reports.issues: Writes to disk directly -- fine for a trace module but the pattern couples phases to the filesystem; in the new build the trace should be a pure value persisted by the shell. _j's fallback to str(o) can silently stringify unexpected objects.

module_reports.purpose: Orchestrator: runs B->A->C->F->D, assembles Result with per-spot confidences, cannot_conclude catalogue, writes result.json/od.npz/warped png; params_hash over a subset of constants.
module_reports.quality: The cannot_conclude catalogue (191-214) is exemplary NN3 material: every entry has a reason AND a bench remedy ('pencil the front', 'lower the exposure'). Status vocabulary (OK/NOT_A_PLATE/NOT_WORKABLE/NEEDS_LANE_MAP) is right. Deterministic given pinned deps. No tests.
module_reports.issues: Violates the pure-pipeline target: analyze() does cv2.imread, imwrite, savez, json.dump inline -- computation and I/O are fused. NN2 absent: no value is tagged measured/chosen/inferred (origin_source/role_source are partial gestures, not a systematic tag). F1: sat_frac>0.10 only caps confidence (floor 0.3, line 147) and adds a caveat -- photometry (share_pct, integrals) is still published at 59% clipping. params_hash (23-34) omits many live constants (GLYPH_FILL, HDR_GAP, SUPPORT_K, VAL_FLOOR, MAD_K, STACK_*, percentiles), giving false reproducibility assurance. Ordering oddity: normalize runs before the gate, so a garbage image is warped before being judged.

module_reports.purpose: Matplotlib dashboard renderer: pixel-faithful OD graph with band highlights and badges, structure overlay, per-lane densitograms, 7-plate summary sheet.
module_reports.quality: Competent presentation code; the pixel-faithful-graph + band-highlight (not circles) decisions are documented against a real user failure. Deterministic.
module_reports.issues: It RE-RUNS the whole analysis from images (load(), line 33-36) instead of reading result.json -- figures can diverge from stored results, and the D-phase status handling (NEEDS_LANE_MAP) is bypassed. Hardcoded filename->plate map. Not worth porting; the new build renders from stored, versioned results.

nonnegotiable_violations: F1 (VIOLATED): clipping fraction never gates photometry. runs/P29/result.json shows sat_frac 0.5919 (59.2% clipped) with status OK and published share_pct values; pipeline.py:147 merely floors the confidence factor at 0.3 and pipeline.py:202-205 adds a caveat. The brief requires refusal of photometry above a threshold. Compounding it, sat_frac is measured post-Lanczos-warp (normalize.py:163), which biases the clipping estimate; it must come from raw pixels.

F4 (VIOLATED, subtly): noise sigma is not measured once before spot masking. normalize.py:159-162 computes MAD on a percentile-trimmed population (below 70th percentile = spots masked out) after an iteratively spot-masked background (normalize.py:148-152), and extract.py:101 RE-estimates sigma per lane from each profile (robust_sigma(prof)) with the plate noise only as a floor. Multiple, order-dependent noise estimates are exactly the subtle inheritance risk the brief warns about.

F11 (HALF-VIOLATED): peak model is symmetric multi-Gaussian (extract.py:66-71), not EMG; tailing biases centroids/integrals feeding share_pct. Streak flagging + quantification suppression IS correctly implemented (extract.py:102-105, pipeline.py:183).

F2 (VIOLATED by omission + hazard): Rst (relative to a standard-lane reference spot) does not exist anywhere. rel_pos is honestly labeled and rf is null without a front, but graph.py:24-30 (to_rf) silently returns three different quantities (true Rf, origin-relative, band-relative) from one function with no tag -- the exact silent-substitution pattern F2 forbids.

F10 (VIOLATED): lane count is inferred from signal alone -- projection peaks UNION dot x-positions UNION pitch extrapolation (structure.py:239-336). It is flagged needs_user_confirmation, but the count is emitted and consumed downstream with no user-supplied lane map input path in the core.

NN1 (HAZARDS, not active violations): (a) confidence.py:24-29 hysteresis makes scores depend on previously stored values -- history-dependent numbers by design; dormant only because pipeline.py never passes `previous`. (b) lanes.py:73-77 VLM_LABEL_CACHE hardcodes identical labels and confidences for all 7 plates via a dict comprehension while claiming 'recorded verbatim' -- VLM-originated confidences flow into user-visible role_conf. (c) vlm_orientation input (pipeline.py:54, normalize.py:116) lets a non-deterministic component set geometry, recorded but not pinned/content-addressed.

NN2 (VIOLATED): no output value is tagged measured/chosen/inferred. origin_source/role_source/from_dot are partial gestures; spot y/sigma/integral/share_pct carry no provenance tag, and extract.py:121-123's curve_fit failure fallback fabricates sigma=6.0 and mu_err=2.0 indistinguishably from fitted values.

NN5 (VIOLATED): no version pinning anywhere -- README installs unpinned numpy/scipy/opencv; cv2 Lanczos warp, Canny, blur all vary across builds/platforms. params_hash (pipeline.py:23-34) covers only a subset of live constants (omits GLYPH_FILL, HDR_GAP, SUPPORT_K, VAL_FLOOR, MAD_K, STACK_*, the 70th-percentile cut, trim params), so byte-identical claims ('Confirmed' in README) hold only same-machine/same-env.

NN4 (BORDERLINE): no accuracy claims appear in outputs, but README claims measured error rates ('mean error 0.049h') and all discriminator constants (DOT_COMPACT=0.68, GLYPH_FILL=0.68, fill-ratio ranges) were calibrated on the same 7 plates they are evaluated on, with no human labels. Confidence numbers (0.95/0.75/0.55) are unvalidated.

Target-stack (VIOLATED): pipeline is not pure -- analyze() does imread/imwrite/savez/json.dump inline (pipeline.py:56-79, 216-219); no FastAPI, no Pydantic, no SQLite, no content-addressed blobs, zero tests.
overlap_with_brief: Substantial overlap on the honest-refusal and provenance philosophy, thin overlap on the letter of the constraints. Well-implemented: NN3 is essentially done -- gate refusals carry name/measured/needed (gate.py), and the cannot_conclude catalogue (pipeline.py:191-214) pairs every refusal with a bench remedy; F5 background is correct (iterative-masked + log-OD, no Kubelka-Munk/rolling-ball, normalize.py:143-164); F11's streak-suppression half works; confidence-with-named-reasons and the replayable trace exceed most first attempts. Partially implemented: determinism is real algorithmically (no RNG, no time) but unpinned (NN5) and undermined by the dormant hysteresis and the fake VLM cache (NN1); lane-role ladder matches the never-guess spirit. Not implemented or violated: F1 clipping gate (the single most consequential gap -- 59%-clipped plates get published percentages), F4 single-early noise measurement, F2 Rst, F10 non-signal lane count, F11 EMG, NN2 tagging, the pure-core/FastAPI/SQLite architecture, and any test suite. The code knows its images are clipped and says so eloquently -- it just refuses to refuse.
recommendation_detail: PORT (algorithms into a new pure, pinned, tested core): normalize.py's to_od background model and _trim_border and find_plate (with noise estimation moved to comply with F4 and sat_frac measured pre-warp); signals.py wholesale (trivial, replace cv2.blur with numpy); structure.py's gutter-median line detection, fill-ratio dot/glyph discrimination, header-band measurement, and pitch completion REWORKED as propose-then-user-confirm to satisfy F10; extract.py's streak fraction, cross-lane stacking, gutter hygiene, Rs pairs, width model, and the fitting framework with EMG substituted for Gaussian and the analytic noise/sqrt(ncols) sigma replacing per-profile re-estimation; the cannot_conclude catalogue and gate Check shape as the NN3 template; trace.py's section schema as a pure value. KEEP (as design reference and regression baseline): the 7 runs/ outputs, the README's deviations list (items 1-7 are hard-won empirical findings about these exact plates -- the signed-OD MAD trap, the header-band trap, the fill-ratio discriminator ranges, the reverted compactness veto), and render.py's presentation decisions (band highlights not circles, pixel-faithful graph). DISCARD: pipeline.py's orchestration (impure, no NN2, no F1 gate -- the new FastAPI/SQLite shell replaces it), lanes.py's VLM_LABEL_CACHE (fabricated-looking stub; NN1 poison), confidence.py's hysteresis (history-dependent numbers by design; keep the Factor/reason/band pattern, drop quantize's `previous` path), render.py's recompute-from-image loading, and the params_hash as-is (rebuild to cover every constant, or better, hash a single frozen Pydantic config). Do not port anything before writing golden-output tests against the existing runs/ JSONs in the pinned environment -- that converts the README's unverifiable 'Determinism: Confirmed' claim into an actual NN5 regression gate.
